title: Chat permissions of the organization
summary: Owners and maintainers choose on the JayV site which chat permissions (run commands, write to Git, use the network) people may switch on in the organization's projects. A blocked permission shows disabled in the chat's Permissions as "Blocked by <organization>" and the agent is never given it.
usage: On the site, open the organization and use the Chat tab: leave on each permission people may use, switch off the ones they may not (run commands, write to Git, use the network) and save. In the app, under Permissions beside the work mode (or Ctrl+K › Command permissions), a blocked permission shows disabled as "Blocked by <organization>". Blocking run commands also removes the commands granted one by one; blocking Git removes every git command; blocking the network removes the commands that reach the network. If an agent asks for such a command, JayV does not ask you: the step says who blocks it. It applies to the whole organization, adds to the command blocks of the Permissions tab and reaches the app at the next sync. In the palette (Ctrl+K), "<organization>: chat permissions (site)" opens the tab.
